disease_profile.stage: Rai Stage III, diagnosed 3 years ago. Failed first-line therapy with FCR (fludarabine, cyclophosphamide, rituximab). Now on second-line treatment.
disease_profile.treatment_regimen: Venetoclax 400 mg daily (ramp-up completed) + Obinutuzumab (completed initial cycles, now on venetoclax maintenance). Monthly blood work.
key_symptoms: Significant fatigue, needs afternoon nap most days
Recurrent infections requiring antibiotics 4-5 times per year
Swollen lymph nodes in neck, armpits, and groin
Unintentional weight loss (5 kg over past year)
Early satiety (feels full quickly, possible spleen enlargement)
disease_profile.trajectory: Currently in treatment and responding. Lymphocyte counts dropped substantially, but still not in complete remission. Physician is cautiously optimistic but has discussed the possibility of needing additional lines of therapy. Tumor lysis syndrome risk was managed during venetoclax ramp-up.

demographics.marital_status: Divorced, lives with adult son who helps with care

causes: Agent Orange exposure during military service in Vietnam
His own behavior (smoked for 20 years, quit at 45)
